text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I wonder who'll win today. I'm leaning toward Mayano Top Gun since I hear she's a long-distance prodigy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Sure, but I really want Fuji Kiseki to do well too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spectators are already starting to get excited for the race. Meanwhile, at the paddock…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, mine enemy, Mayano Top Gun. We meet again, and you're just as carefree and innocent as ever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But watch out. That sweetness of yours might be no more after today.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Is that so? But haven't you heard?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Long distances are my forte. Did you forget that in your shock? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I hope you won't run off crying about how you never want to race again after we're finished!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! What a threat! You should watch what you say, though.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'd hate for you to be traumatized when those words come back to bite you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text: Holy crap, did you hear what Fuji just said? That was so cool! I didn't know she had that side to her!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Fan
text_block_list.text: Mayano's so confident today! It makes her even cuter!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan
text_block_list.text: Seriously! I have my fingers crossed for both of them! Actually, wait… Why are they arguing in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That was good. Thanks for playing along.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This race needed something to spice it up, and it looks like we fired up the crowd just the right amount.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hehe! No problem! ♪ I meant what I said, though. Half of it, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, what a bold declaration of rivalry! I hope you'll go easy on me.
